svg.title: Daily CH₄ and N₂O flux against the daily soil temperature at Anttila (mineral soil), Särkisuo (drained peat) and Viikki (clay loam): median per 1 °C bin with the 25 to 75 % band, and the Q₁₀ fit.
svg.desc: Two panels, one above the other: CH₄ flux (µmol m⁻² s⁻¹, top) and N₂O flux (nmol m⁻² s⁻¹, bottom) against the daily mean soil temperature (°C, shared x axis; Anttila and Särkisuo at 5 cm, Viikki at 14 cm). Each line is the median of the daily means per 1 °C bin with the 25 to 75 % band; the dotted lines are Q₁₀ fits. CH₄: Anttila: ρ −0.06 (n = 724 days), tsoil −0.2 to 23.8 °C, largest bin median 0.000303 µmol CH₄ m⁻² s⁻¹ at 16.5 °C, no Q₁₀ fit (bins with median > 0 are less than 75% of the bins); Särkisuo: ρ 0.82 (n = 504 days), tsoil 0.2 to 19.1 °C, largest bin median 0.0730 µmol CH₄ m⁻² s⁻¹ at 13.5 °C, Q₁₀ 4.65 (95 % CI 2.50 to 8.64). N₂O: Anttila: ρ 0.17 (n = 724 days), tsoil −0.2 to 23.8 °C, largest bin median 0.282 nmol N₂O m⁻² s⁻¹ at 18.5 °C, Q₁₀ 2.06 (95 % CI 1.40 to 3.03); Särkisuo: ρ 0.64 (n = 504 days), tsoil 0.2 to 19.1 °C, largest bin median 1.67 nmol N₂O m⁻² s⁻¹ at 17.5 °C, Q₁₀ 3.25 (95 % CI 1.67 to 6.30); Viikki: ρ −0.07 (n = 1326 days), tsoil −2.4 to 22.4 °C, largest bin median 1.26 nmol N₂O m⁻² s⁻¹ at 12.5 °C, Q₁₀ 0.91 (95 % CI 0.57 to 1.43). CH₄ against soil temperature: Anttila no clear monotonic relation; Särkisuo a strong positive relation. N₂O against soil temperature: Anttila a weak positive relation; Särkisuo a strong positive relation; Viikki no clear monotonic relation. The fluxes are gap-filled values. Flux > 0 = emission.
